We're back to winter! For a moment at least. Depending on where you are on the property we are looking at 3-6" of new snow. It's great to see snow on the trees and watch brown turn to white. 

We are out snowmobile grooming this morning to pin things down. Coverage will be variable but there will be great skiing to be had. Come on out and enjoy a day of winter before the thaw!

Reported on Mar 6, 2026 at 7:13 AM by Mitch
